text:
Platinum Price in 2004
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2004, the LBMA platinum price rose 2.6% between 2004-01-30 ($837) and 2004-12-30 ($859). The highest sampled price was $903 in March and the lowest was $793 in June. The mean of these observations was $845. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
